[Benzinga news, 2026-11-02T19:02:09Z, by staff] Omnicom Appoints Tom Schwenger as CEO of Omnicom Health Marketing
Omnicom Group Inc. has appointed Tom Schwenger as the new CEO of its health marketing business, effective immediately, succeeding Dana Maiman.
Omnicom Group Inc. announced the appointment of Tom Schwenger as the Chief Executive Officer of its health marketing business, Omnicom Health, effective November 2, 2026. Schwenger, who joins the company from Veeva Systems, will oversee the unit's global marketing agencies. He succeeds Dana Maiman, who is departing the company. The leadership transition involves the oversight of Omnicom Health's specialized marketing services, which leverage the company's proprietary data and identity platform, Omni, to serve life sciences and pharmaceutical clients.
